summary: China Yuchai International filed a Form 6-K announcing that all resolutions set out in its Notice of Annual General Meeting dated July 7, 2026 were duly passed at the AGM held in Singapore on August 6, 2026. The press release confirms routine shareholder approvals but does not disclose specific resolution details, vote counts, or any special-situation transactions such as mergers, acquisitions, or capital actions. The filing is a routine current report of AGM results by a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms, advisors, or strategic event indicated.
